title: GHA Indie Worker embedding and discovery surface
$comment: HUMAN-AUTHORED PEER AUTHORITY of contracts/typespec/discovery.tsp. Neither is generated from the other. Persisted ComparisonSpace and Finding live in contract.schema.json; this document covers the request/response bodies.

AnnStrategy.description: Index strategy. Anything but `halfvec_exact` can return a wrong neighbour.

Evidence.description: What has been measured about a comparison space. Every field must be true before an approximate strategy may be enabled. `analysis::embedding::Evidence`.

migrationReplay.description: The space survives a replay of every migration that touches it.

tenantIsolation.description: No query in the space can return another tenant's row.

lexicalOnlyRetrieval.description: Retrieval still works with vectors switched off, so a regression is not silent.

exactVsAnnRecall.description: Exact scan and the approximate index were compared and the recall recorded.

rollback.description: The change can be rolled back without dropping the column.

backupRestore.description: A backup taken before the change restores cleanly.

EnableSpaceRequest.description: Turn a comparison space on. Refused unless the evidence supports the requested strategy.

measuredRecall.description: Measured recall against exact scan, in [0, 1]. Required for anything but `halfvec_exact`.

SearchRequest.description: A nearest-neighbour query inside one comparison space.

text.description: Query text. Encoded with the space's own prompt profile, never a different one.

minScore.description: Reject neighbours below this similarity. Absent means return the top K regardless.

Neighbour.description: One neighbour. `score` is in the space's own metric, normalized to [0, 1].

excerpt.description: The chunk that matched, for a human to read. Never the whole document.

SearchResponse.description: Answer to a search. `exact` is false when an approximate index served the query, so a caller can tell a measured answer from an estimated one.
